thread:
maria: Quick ping — I'm landing a refactor of the Optimize toolkit docs focused on quant profiles + batching examples. Opening PR in a few mins: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/XXXX :wave:

alex: nice. what's changing conceptually?

maria: Mostly naming and structure. We currently have mixed terms — 'heuristics', 'profiles', and 'presets' used interchangeably. I'm consolidating to 'quant profiles' and 'batching policies' and moving examples into a single 'examples/' subdir.

taylor: sounds good. can we keep a short compatibility note? customers might have links to old sections.

maria: yes — plan is a small redirect table and a one-liner per removed page. Also adding 301 redirects in the site config.

priyam: for the quant profile examples, can you add a tiny CSV of sample latency/cost numbers? that helped SRE last time.

maria: good call. I'll include a CSV and a brief chart. sample file will be under examples/quant-profile-summaries.csv.

alex: SDK snippet question: is it okay to show both Python and Node? we don't want to bloat docs.

maria: lean, yes. one compact Python snippet + a one-line Node call. here's the Python snippet I'm planning to include:

```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient

client = OptimizeClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
policy = {
    "batching_policy": {"max_tokens": 512, "max_batch_ms": 20},
    "cache": {"prefix_cache": true, "ttl_seconds": 3600},
    "quant_profile": "q4_0"
}
resp = client.optimize.run(model="redwood-1-large", policy=policy, prompt="Summarize the note")
print(resp.text)
```

taylor: that looks good. maybe add a tiny note about when to pick q4_0 vs q8_0 (latency vs quality).

maria: will add a 2-line decision table.

docs-bot: Reminder — please add a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md and set the PR label docs/optimize.

maria: done, changelog entry added.

priyam: CI — we need a basic lint + linkcheck for moved pages. otherwise links will 404.

maria: agreed. I'm adding a small test in .github/workflows/docs-ci.yml that runs htmlproofer on the built site and a link-checker step that tolerates internal redirects. snippet below:

```yaml
name: Docs CI
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  linkcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Install ruby deps
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ruby ruby-dev build-essential
      - name: Run htmlproofer
        run: gem install html-proofer && htmlproofer ./public --allow-hash-href
```

alex: can you post the PR link when it's up? i'll do a review pass for accuracy of the batch examples.

maria: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — tagging @alex @taylor @priyam for review.

deploy-bot: (automated) preview site published: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 7 days) :rocket:

taylor: preview looks good, small nit on wording in the cache section. sending a suggestion in the PR. :pen:

maria: great, thanks. plan to merge after approvals and CI green. will post a short announcement in #general once merged. :thumbsup:
